briefdescription.para: macOS variable inspection and stack frame queries via liblldb SB API.

detaileddescription.para: Platform counterpart to SessionInspection.cpp (Windows dbgeng). Implements Session methods for DAP variables, scopes, stackTrace, and evaluate requests. Uses SBFrame::GetVariables for locals/args, SBValue tree for structured inspection, and SBFrame::EvaluateExpression for watch/hover evaluation.
